hints.title: Equation Inversion
hints.text: The condition val xor first == second is equivalent to val == first xor second.

hints.title: Bounded Length Bound
hints.text: Because values are bounded by 10^9, their bit length is at most 30. Any matching substring in s needs to be at most 30 characters long.

hints.title: Lookup Precomputation
hints.text: Iterate through all substrings of length 1 to 30 and record the earliest start index for each distinct integer value.

hints.title: Precomputed Substring Lookup Implementation

complexity.notes: Precomputing 30 lengths takes 30 * n steps; each query lookup is O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching for substring matches per query takes O(q * n) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(30 * n) hash map storage for fast query answers.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes the small bit length ceiling (<= 30) of integers up to 10^9.
